text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment 
inspection I2,which must be carried out 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the little block.
The high 
pressure steam drum functions:
Receiving water from high pressure economizer.
Acting 
 as a reservoir for the suction of high pressure circulating pumps.
Receiving water and steam from high pressure evaporator.
Acting 
 as the source of steam to the super heater.
The Drum technical data:
Medium | Water / Steam | No. of drums | 8
Operating pressure | 38 bar | Design press. | 51 bar
Operating temp. | 249 C | Design temp. | 266 C
The first 
draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Saada, revised by eng. Ahmed Elsaaedy, 
accepted by eng. Magdey Hegazy, approved by eng. Khamis Elsherif Maintenance 
General Manager and approved by eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby Head Sector of 
Mahmoudia Power Station.
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC Inspection & Quality Control 
General Manager & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb 
Inspection & Quality Controls Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be 
 trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet, 
 breathing mask ... etc.
Put red tag on the high pressure super heater.
The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding the zone of 
 work.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Work
to be Carried Out
Open the drum manhole
Clean the drum
Check bolts of manhole and repair or change if necessary.
Change manhole gasket.
Change insulation.
Change gasket of standpipe vent and drain flanges.
Check safety valve and repair or change if necessary.
Check level gauges and repair or change if necessary.
Check valves of level gauges and repair or change if necessary.
Check portholes of chemical injection spray nozzle and repair or change if 
 necessary.
Check bolts, wire mesh and vanes of steam drier and repair or change if 
 necessary.
Check bolts and plates of return case and repair or change if necessary.
